We need to respond. The user wants to unlock doors and turn on headlights. We have a tool for setHeadlights. But we don't have a tool for unlocking doors. There's a tool for displayCarStatus, but not for unlocking doors. There's no tool for unlocking doors. The user wants to unlock doors. We cannot do that. We can only do what we have. We can turn on headlights. We can also display car status for doors. But we cannot unlock them. So we should respond that we can't unlock doors. We can turn on headlights. We can also display door status. So we can do that. We can call setHeadlights with mode "on". Then we can call displayCarStatus with option "doors" to show status. That might help. We can also ask if they want to see door status. But we can just do it. So we can call setHeadlights. Then we can call displayCarStatus. That is the best we can do.
